339-677-1115-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
339-677-1115-7272.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

323-4279-7316--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
323-4279-7316--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble, Rat King and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Rat King ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

3480-4770-6006-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1339-2835-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2835-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Fecundity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1479-2841-4677-8100.easyPrerequisites:
(optional)You control an Elf or have an Elf card in hand. Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Elven Passage.
1479-2841-4677-8100.description:
Fetch a land using Elven Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Zendikar's Roil and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1224-2060-7889.description:
Cast Psychic Pickpocket by paying its mana cost.
Dancing from Dark to Dawn's first ability triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Psychic Pickpocket spell. When it enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4}{U}.
Repeat.

4050-4067-5003-7848.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four graveyards that each have seven or more cards in them.
4050-4067-5003-7848.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing The Master of Lake-town.
When The Master of Lake-town dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Master of Lake-town trigger, drawing a card for each graveyard that has seven or more cards in it.
Holding priority, activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent
Repeat steps 4 and 5 until you have {4} or more available.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return The Master of Lake-town from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
4050-4067-5003-7848.notes: If your graveyard has six cards in it, you can count that as one of the graveyards with seven cards in it, as The Master of Lake-town will count as the seventh card. If the permanent taps for more than {1}, there can be less graveyards with seven cards in them.

670-1619-4865-5400.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4865-5400.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Vesuvan Shapeshifter and Synth Infiltrator each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Vesuvan Shapeshifter trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4865-5400.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

4200-5998-6867-7055.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1849-2590-5776-7313.description:
Activate another creature you control, which is a Food due to Ygra, by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Ygra and Experimental Confectioner trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Experimental Confectioner trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Repeat.

1368-4885-6321-6723.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4885-6321-6723.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2104-5144-5913.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Pinnacle Monk and exiling Ephemerate.
When Pinnacle Monk enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Pinnacle Monk
When Pinnacle Monk enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2097-3809-4917-5200.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two other artifact creatures.
2097-3809-4917-5200.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact creature, creating three Treasure tokens due to Jolene.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact creature, creating three Treasure tokens due to Jolene.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Treasure, creating two 1/1 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Repeat.
2097-3809-4917-5200.notes:
Once you have infinite mana and Treasure tokens, you can use Jan Jansen's second ability, paired with untapping it, infinitely to get infinite Construct tokens.
Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

117-1618-2440-3992.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Talrand
117-1618-2440-3992.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Cyclical Evolution.
Cyclical Evolution triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Talrand triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Cyclical Evolution.
Repeat.
117-1618-2440-3992.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Talrand. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Lancers en-Kor.
The Lancers en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Lancers en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Rakdos.
Repeat.

1495-4120-7061.easyPrerequisites: Triskelion has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1495-4120-7061.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
1495-4120-7061.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

1978-5089-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.

Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding {U} for each Clue you control
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary.
Repeat from step 2.

Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

Resolve the Builder's Talent trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

245-1069-5499-6791.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.

Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Nykthos.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

5225-6323.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Jumbo Cactuar.

Declare Jumbo Cactuar as an attacker, triggering its ability, giving it +9999/+0 until end of turn.
Cast Peema Aether-Seer by paying {3}{G}.
When Peema Aether-Seer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get 10,000 {E}.

An opponent is unable to block and kill Emissary Green
You have at least three opponents
Emissary Green does not have summoning sickness.

Declare Emissary Green as an attacker. Emissary Green triggers, causing you to create a number of Treasure tokens and put a number of +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
If you control a Treasure, activate it by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.

Repeat step 5 until you have {3}{R}{R} available.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

222-527-955-2292.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.

When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

Resolve Ivy Lane Denizen's trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve Blasting Station's trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Aether Channeler, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating a Food or a Treasure token.

757-4235-4348.description:

Activate Ley Druid by tapping it targeting Magosi.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; choose not to pay for it.

Rings of Brighthearth triggers; pay {2} and copy the Magosi ability.
Resolve both copies of the ability, cancelling out your skipped turn and taking an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

1561-2720.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has cards in their library greater than their life total.
1561-2720.description:
Cast Peer Into the Abyss targeting an opponent.
That player loses half their life and draws half their library.
They are then dealt damage by Underworld Dreams equal to the amount of cards they drew.
